video_title: Pistons' Ebuka Okorie Tries to Escape Awkward Questions in 2K | Deflected w/ Labaron Philon Jr.

quotes.speaker: Ebuka Okorie
quotes.summary_phrase: Ebuka Okorie on being cooked by Anthony Batson Jr.
quotes.excerpt: He hit me with some quick crossover, got in the paint, just caught it back, dunked it on the center.
quotes.quote: One of our redshirts, Anthony Batson Jr., we were doing some fast break drill and he hit me with some quick crossover, got in the paint, just caught it back, dunked it on the center and I was like, wow. Yeah, that was a good play by him.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his Mississippi State performance
quotes.excerpt: I was just in real deal flow state in that game.
quotes.quote: I probably anybody on Mississippi State. I was just in real deal flow state in that game. But it was just one play, I got in transition and I backed it out, one, two and I hit him with an in-and-out, nobody was in front of me and I just went and laid the ball up with so much ease. If I get any type of space, it's over with. Any space is done.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on Jacob Martin's pre-game speeches
quotes.excerpt: Jacob Martin during the end of the year, his speeches got worse and worse.
quotes.quote: Probably one of our walk-ons, Jacob Martin, during the end of the year, his speeches got worse and worse. We went on a win streak, Coach Oats, he told him like, before every game he used to be like, 'Jacob, you got the guys ready?' Nobody knew he was saying, like, we just used to be like, 'Yeah, yeah,' and push him around in a circle, so it was cool. That was a good moment.

quotes.speaker: Ebuka Okorie
quotes.summary_phrase: Ebuka Okorie on Oskar Giltey's music taste
quotes.excerpt: Oskar Giltay, I probably say he had the worst music taste.
quotes.quote: One of my teammates, Oskar Giltay, I probably say he had the worst music taste because he's Belgian and he played some Belgian music in the locker room. I was acting like I was vibing with it, but it wasn't that good, I'm not going to lie.

quotes.speaker: Ebuka Okorie
quotes.summary_phrase: Ebuka Okorie on Georgia Tech's overconfidence
quotes.excerpt: They had some type of confidence to them, they thought they were going to win the game.
quotes.quote: I probably say Georgia Tech just because I had 40 that game. They had some type of confidence to them, they thought they were going to win the game. I think we ended up winning by 15, something like that.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on crossing up Tre Johnson
quotes.excerpt: Tre Johnson, if I played the Wizards and he guarded me, I'm going to definitely try to cross him up.
quotes.quote: Tre Johnson, if I played the Wizards and he guarded me, I'm going to definitely try to cross him up every chance I get. You know that's my old teammate too. If it's a superstar, Sengun. Sengun for sure.

quotes.speaker: Ebuka Okorie
quotes.summary_phrase: Ebuka Okorie on Maliq Brown's defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: It was a big man on Duke, the one that plays defense a lot.
quotes.quote: I don't remember his name, I don't want to get his name wrong, but it was a big man on Duke, the one that plays defense a lot. Maliq Brown. I'm not going to lie, that was a bad game for us. We were down a lot. But it was like the end of the game and he was like, 'Dang, they're still trying?' That was pretty disrespectful.

quotes.speaker: Ebuka Okorie
quotes.summary_phrase: Ebuka Okorie on Kevin Durant following him on Instagram
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant actually followed me on Instagram, so that was surprising.
quotes.quote: I say for me, Kevin Durant actually followed me on Instagram, so that was surprising.
